title: Automated compliance gating and triage scorer
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Enterprise and mid-market customers submit a high volume of security and compliance asks (SOC2/ISO questions, HIPAA inquiries, GDPR/DPA negotiations, vendor questionnaires). The current intake is manual, inconsistent, and slow: support and solutions engineers hand off tickets to PM or Security with little structure. This leads to long SLAs, duplicated work, and missed contractual commitments.

Goal: Create an automated scoring and gating system for incoming compliance requests that classifies, scores, and routes asks within defined SLAs. The system should reduce manual triage, surface high-risk items to Security/Legal faster, and enable automated responses for low-risk recurring questions. The outcome should be measurable: 60% reduction in time-to-first-triage, 40% of questionnaire items auto-routed/auto-answered, and clear dashboards for backlog and throughput.
proposal: Build a two-phase solution: (1) Rules-first MVP scorer embedded in the intake form that assigns a risk/priority score based on structured fields; (2) Iterative enhancement with lightweight ML classifier trained on historical triage decisions to improve routing. Scoring dimensions: compliance type (SOC2/ISO/HIPAA/GDPR), data sensitivity (PHI/PII/none), contract trigger (DPA required/custom clause), customer tier (enterprise/dedicated), exposure surface (public API/internal only), deadline urgency (contract SLA/date), and questionnaire complexity (freeform vs. standard vendor Q). Each dimension maps to a numeric weight; final score buckets: Low (auto-respond or support template), Medium (PM review, 48h SLA), High (escalate to Security + Legal, 24h SLA). Implement a small rule engine in the intake form first (no ML) to unlock immediate gains, while instrumenting labels and decisions for later model training.
acceptance_criteria: Intake form updated with structured fields and required classification fields (compliance_type, data_sensitivity, customer_tier, contract_trigger, urgency).
Automated scorer runs on form submission and assigns one of three buckets: Low / Medium / High.
Routing rules created: Low -> Support/SE auto-response templates; Medium -> PM queue with 48h triage SLA; High -> Security + Legal alert with 24h triage SLA.
Dashboard tile in Console for compliance intake shows: time-to-first-triage, percent auto-handled, backlog by bucket.
Seed set of response templates for top 10 recurring vendor questions available to Support/SE.
implementation_plan: Week 1: Workshop with Security, Legal, Support, Solutions Engineering to finalize scoring dimensions and weights (deliverable: scoring rubric doc).
Week 2: Update intake form (internal) and API webhook to include structured fields; implement rule-based scorer service (lambda) that returns bucket and routing tag.
Week 3: Wire routing into Linear/Support workflows: Low -> canned response draft + close candidate; Medium -> PM queue; High -> Security PagerDuty/Slack channel + Legal ticket.
Week 4: Instrument metrics and dashboards (Console tile + internal Grafana): time-to-first-triage, percent auto, false-positive rate.
Week 5-8: Collect labeled traffic, run weekly reviews, refine rules; build training dataset for ML classifier; plan ML pilot for Q2.
stakeholders: Backend Engineering - Runtime team lead (assigned during sprint planning)
metrics: Time-to-first-triage (target median <= 24h for High, <= 48h for Medium)
Percent of incoming asks auto-routed/auto-answered (target >= 40% within 90 days)
False positive rate for High bucket (target < 5%)
Backlog size by bucket (target 0 High backlog older than 24h)
